subject: Myth: a bigger context window means your AI remembers
script: Myth: a bigger context window means your AI remembers your project. It doesn't. A bigger window just holds more inside one chat. Start a new chat, and it's empty again. Size isn't memory. Memory is what survives between chats. Flayel keeps that: your vision, stack, progress and decisions, in one Project Brain. Any new chat, any tool, one shortcut, and it's all back. Big windows are great. They just need something to fill them. Try Flayel free at flayel dot com.
